finding: The ordinary compiled GET draft observes the actor and serialized response, but neither crosses back into the originating isolate's private retention Set. Actor finishLate/written cannot establish cancellation or actual/first/deadline settlement in M. Original stage-work has no exported count/identity observer. Its retain function returns the exact input Promise (16–24), adds it to the private Set, and installs its own settled reaction. observeFiniteOwnerRequestWork creates the original scope and retains an outer operation Promise (67–74). wire26–39 retains actual before Promise.race. ctx.waitUntil receives actual.catch(()=>{}), which is a distinct derived Promise with the same settlement dependency. Requiring reference equality between actual and waitUntil's argument would be incorrect.
